tools.name: solar-design_string-sizing
tools.description: Compute minimum and maximum modules per series string and maximum parallel strings per MPPT from module temperature coefficients, site temperatures and inverter DC limits. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/string-sizing. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_dc-ac-ratio-check
tools.description: Compute the DC/AC ratio and optionally estimate AC energy and clipping from a caller DC power series with constant efficiency or a PVWatts inverter curve. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/dc-ac-ratio-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_poa-irradiance-transpose
tools.description: Compute plane-of-array irradiance with isotropic, Hay-Davies or Perez sky models and NREL SPA solar geometry from caller irradiance records. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/poa-irradiance-transpose. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_energy-yield-estimate
tools.description: Estimate AC energy from caller POA irradiance and temperatures using the PVWatts v5 DC and inverter models with a transparent loss stack. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/energy-yield-estimate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_row-spacing
tools.description: Compute row height, shadow gap, row pitch and ground coverage ratio that avoid row-to-row shading at a design sun position. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/row-spacing. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_horizon-shading-loss
tools.description: Estimate beam and isotropic sky-diffuse losses caused by a caller far-field horizon profile against sun positions and beam POA. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/horizon-shading-loss. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_system-loss-stack
tools.description: Combine individual loss percentages into a total system loss using PVWatts multiplicative derating, with optional defaults for missing categories. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/system-loss-stack. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_battery-backup-sizing
tools.description: Size battery energy and inverter continuous/surge power needed to back up critical loads for a target autonomy with DoD and efficiency derates. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/battery-backup-sizing. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_tariff-savings
tools.description: Compute bill savings from caller interval generation and load under a time-of-use tariff with export credit, net metering or no export value. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/tariff-savings. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_financial-payback
tools.description: Compute simple payback, NPV, IRR and LCOE from capex, incentives, year-1 energy, degradation, O&M and price escalation. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/financial-payback. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_module-layout-fit
tools.description: Maximise the number of modules on a roof-face polygon with caller setbacks, orientation, gaps and obstruction polygons. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/module-layout-fit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_nec-690-current
tools.description: Compute PV circuit maximum current and minimum conductor ampacity using NEC 690.8 125% factors for the selected code edition. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/nec-690-current. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_module-spec-compare
tools.description: Normalise and compare module datasheet values for efficiency, W/m², temperature-adjusted power, price per watt and warranty retention. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/module-spec-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: solar-design_pan-ond-parse
tools.description: Parse PVsyst PAN (module) and OND (inverter) text files into nested raw JSON and a normalised datasheet object. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/solar-design/pan-ond-parse. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "solar-design" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: solar-design_dc-ac-ratio-check, solar-design_tariff-savings · Private data: solar-design_poa-irradiance-transpose, solar-design_pan-ond-parse · Public sink: solar-design_string-sizing, solar-design_dc-ac-ratio-check, solar-design_poa-irradiance-transpose, solar-design_energy-yield-estimate, solar-design_row-spacing, solar-design_horizon-shading-loss, solar-design_system-loss-stack, solar-design_battery-backup-sizing, solar-design_tariff-savings, solar-design_financial-payback, solar-design_module-layout-fit, solar-design_nec-690-current, solar-design_module-spec-compare, solar-design_pan-ond-parse · Destructive: solar-design_string-sizing, solar-design_dc-ac-ratio-check, solar-design_poa-irradiance-transpose, solar-design_energy-yield-estimate, solar-design_row-spacing, solar-design_horizon-shading-loss, solar-design_system-loss-stack, solar-design_battery-backup-sizing, solar-design_tariff-savings, solar-design_financial-payback, solar-design_module-layout-fit, solar-design_nec-690-current, solar-design_module-spec-compare, solar-design_pan-ond-parse.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
